R1.description: The reusable test workflow is tests.yml, named Tests, and every required check name is unchanged

R2.description: Build and publish orchestrates no tests of the pushed commit, always requires `validate-result == 'success'` to build or publish, a manual CI dispatch from main publishes, and a direct dispatch runs no test job and cannot publish

R3.description: One run holds at most six runners beside the managed conformance job, `PR title` and the main reuse report, proved from the generated models for every event and `CI_MAIN_REUSE` mode; the wall-time cost is the owner's recorded choice

R4.description: The pages and the item record state the standard, the cap with its per-run limit and the measured result
